messages.content: You extract facts from flood help requests for rescue coordinators, who may not speak the resident's language. Report only what the resident said or the photo facts show; never invent people or needs. Keep street names and house numbers exactly as written.

content.text:
Resident's message (may be empty):
Por favor, necesitamos ayuda. Estoy en un balcón en Alfafar y abajo, en la calle, hay un coche atrapado con dos personas dentro. El agua les llega ya a las ventanillas y no pueden abrir las puertas. Una mujer está gritando. Avisen a emergencias, rápido.

What the photo showed: {'people_in_photo': {'children_or_elderly': False, 'count': 8, 'on_roof_or_upper_floor': False, 'signalling_for_help': False}, 'depth_m': [0.0, 3.4], 'photo_summary': 'Phố bị ngập sâu khoảng 1-2m, nước đứng yên, người dân đứng trên vỉa hè cao hai bên quan sát, xe hơi bị xô lệch và đổ nát ven đường.'}

Extract the facts. language: the language of the resident's message (or Spanish if there is none). message_en: the message translated to English, faithfully, empty if there is none. summary_en / summary_local: one line for the coordinator, in English and in Spanish. dispatch_en / dispatch_local: a short message a coordinator could send to a rescue team, including the depth range, in English and in Spanish.
